name: Build Logic!
desc:
Build Logic is a sandbox construction game where creativity meets logic - build anything, even intelligent things!

❗ Game is 16+? Please check out the latest post in the group. Thx!

🌵 Update: Extended Friend Join Access, Improved Debug Menu & Server Health, Improved Grid System

🔨 Build anything, from simple blocks to digital components!
🖥️ Host and manage your own Public Server!
✨ Build amazing stuff with your friends!

📕 Useful Keybinds:
	[R,T,Y] Rotate Item
	[SHIFT] Sprint (Super Speed)
	[/] Focus Chat + Command Prefix
	... other shortcuts available under Settings > Client Settings > Edit Keybinds!

👍 Leave a like with a comment, I read them all :]

🔗 If you need help or have any idea / bug ⬇
	My group: https://www.roblox.com/groups/6127410
